retained_color_contract.source: Existing decoded SFL metadata only; same cache/profile and metadata SHA checks as the original contract. No new REA question or original asset read.
retained_color_contract.record_index_basis: Existing root_record values are zero-based sequences array indices; each recorded sample is a complete retained root record, never a tween interpolation.
retained_color_contract.composition: For a root-to-leaf chain, initialize M=(1,1,1,1), A=(0,0,0,0); append child (m,a) as A = M*a + A, M = M*m. Result = M*source_RGBA + A before any renderer clamp or shader. Absent transform is explicit identity in the added chain.

offgray.meaning: RGB replacement on cursor middle/end/gray carrier shape coverage; not multiply by 0.19921875 and not evidence of original image ink.

retained_color_contract.confirmation_limit: Per-record retained colors include the selected strip color surviving into confirmation and subsequent source opacity/removal. Confirm terminal may have zero leaves. The source check mark is separately gated by native history; its local identity color is not visibility proof.
retained_color_contract.raster_limit: All original raster pixels for these four families remain unavailable in the provided bank/cache paths already checked. Known color transforms do not recover texture alpha coverage, baked gradients, line ink, title letters, icon contents, blend/shader behavior or original rendered pixels.
retained_color_contract.timing_limit: Each actual source record is preserved; no assertion of runtime milliseconds, active child labels, native mode transition timing or extra animation is added.

retained_color_followup.check: Every existing snapshot path/ref/rect matched retained metadata before augmentation. All 225 selection/confirmation records replayed; only color data added.
